description: In front of the hands on the red bedspread are a small white bench/nightstand piece with a knob and an open lower cavity, and a separate white drawer box. The left hand holds the bench steady while the right hand grasps the loose drawer, lifts it up and moves it left toward the opening, then slides it straight into the cavity until it sits flush; both hands briefly adjust and then the right hand releases, leaving the bench with two aligned drawer fronts.
